cards.title: Moon Muffin Sticky Note Counter Glow

cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Draw the tray clue first, then write one tone-filled sentence under it: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-out line: Try another moon muffin market sentence with a new gentle tone: ____________________.
